SearchResourcesResponse.description: A heterogeneous search projection whose items identify resources through typed references.

DataSourceOptionList.description: Dynamic connection setup options in the canonical list envelope.

ConnectionScopeList.description: OAuth2 scope observations in the canonical list envelope.

Notification.description: A read-only actor-specific projection of a durable notification record.

ListNotificationsResponse.description: A Kubernetes-style list of actor-visible Notification projections.

ListConnectorGenerationsResponse.description: A Kubernetes-style list of connector generations.

ListRateLimitsResponse.description: A Kubernetes-style list of rate limits.

RequestEvent.description: An immutable, resource-shaped HTTP event projection; it is not a client-managed desired resource.

ListRequestEventsResponse.description: A paginated list of immutable RequestEvent projections.

Task.description: A safe task-status projection addressed by an opaque tracking token.

TaskQueue.description: A read-only projection of an Asynq queue.

TaskExecution.description: An administrative projection of one Asynq task.

TaskQueueHistory.description: A requested time window and the observed daily queue samples.

WorkflowInstance.description: A read-only workflow execution projection; metadata.id is the execution ID.
